en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Yasser, 
(It has been narrated) from Al Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘An example of the seeking of the Forgiveness is like an example of a leaf upon a tree you are shaking, so it falls off, and the Forgiven one from sins, and he (still) goes and does it (again), is like the one mocking with his Lord<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Yasir from al-Rida (a.s.) who has said the following: “
A plea for forgiveness is like shaking a tree from which leaves fall off. One who pleas forgiveness and commits sins is like one who derides his Lord.”
